description: Named Mastah on the panel: it broadcasts the clock and reset it is given over the network, as UDP messages on port 7000, so that copies of Rack on other computers can run to the same clock

inputs.text: Each rise above 0V broadcasts a clock message
Each rise above 0V broadcasts a reset message

notes: The status lamp lights red if the network socket cannot be opened, or if a message cannot be sent
Messages are broadcast to 192.168.1.255; for any other network, set IPAddress in MockbaModular.json in Rack's user folder, which the plugin writes there the first time it loads
The maker reports that wired Ethernet carries the messages more reliably than wireless
